channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Record-breaking fuel hike pushes petrol prices above R30 per litre in Gauteng
item.description: South African motorists face unavoidable fuel price increases exceeding R3 per litre starting next week.

item.title: Federal Reserve rate above 5% would trigger global economic damage, Bank of America warns
item.description: The Bank of America estimates that interest rates exceeding 5 per cent could push the global economy into crisis, even as major central banks continue raising borrowing costs.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula face off in high-stakes presidential runoff vote
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and President Lula will compete in a second-round presidential runoff on October 25.

item.title: Singapore Authorities Impound 91 Deregistered Vehicles in Massive September Islandwide Crackdown
item.description: The Land Transport Authority and Singapore Police Force seized 91 vehicles in September for operating without valid Certificates of Entitlement or road tax.

item.title: One-point field goal gives Roosters 19-18 grand final thriller over Knights
item.description: The Sydney Roosters defeated the Newcastle Knights 19-18 in the 2026 NRL grand final, with Daly Cherry-Evans's field goal in the 70th minute proving decisive after the Roosters came back from 12-0 down.

item.title: Isabelle Kelly captains Jillaroos squad as Tarryn Aiken replaces legend Ali Brigginshaw
item.description: Coach Jess Skinner named a 23-player Australian squad for the 2026 Rugby League World Cup while omitting retiring icon Ali Brigginshaw.

item.title: Indianapolis Colts Rout Washington Commanders 30-13 Amidst London Ticket Price Cuts
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts defeated the Washington Commanders 30-13 in London after the NFL slashed ticket prices to boost attendance at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tops first round as Brazil election heads to run-off
item.description: Neither candidate secured 50% of the vote, forcing a presidential run-off scheduled for 25 October.

item.title: Rasmus Hojlund penalty fires Denmark to 1-0 Nations League victory over Wales
item.description: Wales suffered a 1-0 defeat to Denmark in Cardiff as Rasmus Hojlund scored the game's only goal from a 75th-minute penalty.

item.title: Golden State Valkyries Host Las Vegas Aces in 2026 WNBA Playoff Semifinals
item.description: The Golden State Valkyries and Las Vegas Aces begin their five-game semifinal playoff series on Sunday, Oct. 4, at the Chase Center.

item.title: Goncalo Ramos clinches late winner as Erling Haaland limps off injured
item.description: Goncalo Ramos scored a 79th-minute winner to secure a 2-1 Nations League victory for Portugal over Norway.

item.title: Braves seize momentum as bullpen masterclass topples Dodgers in Game 2
item.description: The Atlanta Braves tied their NLDS series at 1-1 by defeating the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2 on Sunday behind a six-pitcher bullpen effort.

item.title: Golden State Valkyries Clinch WNBA Semifinal Game 1 Win Over Las Vegas
item.description: The Golden State Valkyries defeated the Las Vegas Aces 71-60 on Sunday afternoon to take a 1-0 lead in the WNBA Semifinals.

item.title: Vancouver Canucks hunt consecutive victories hosting Vegas Golden Knights at Rogers Arena
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks face the Vegas Golden Knights Sunday at 6 p.m. PT following a 4-1 win over Calgary.

item.title: Temi Nkem Snatches ₦160 Million Grand Prize After 70 Days of Competition
item.description: The 21-year-old content creator secured victory in the Big Brother Naija Season 11 grand finale on Sunday after outlasting 23 other housemates.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney-backed Novig valuation surges to $2 billion after provocative campaign
item.description: Actress Sydney Sweeney's controversial Novig sports trading campaign triggered a massive 94% increase in platform trading volume following its September launch.

item.title: Liam Lawson storms to seventh after best career start in Malaysia
item.description: Liam Lawson surged from 11th to fourth on the opening lap before securing a seventh-place finish at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

item.title: President Marcos leads mass promotion for over 4,000 teachers and education staff
item.description: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. celebrated National Teachers' Day on Monday by swearing in more than 4,000 promoted educators and personnel in Santiago, Isabela.

item.title: Chuba Hubbard scores 15-yard touchdown to hand Panthers early game lead
item.description: Carolina Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard recorded a 15-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter against the Detroit Lions.

item.title: Costa Rica battles Haiti Sunday to clinch Nations League Category A spot
item.description: Costa Rica hosts Haiti this Sunday at Estadio Ricardo Saprissa to secure its position in the Concacaf Nations League Category A.

item.title: AFL Trade Period Starts With Star Pursuits And Pick Swap Deals
item.description: The 2026 Continental Tyres AFL Trade Period officially opened today with clubs across the league actively negotiating player movements and draft selections.

item.title: Jaymie Graham clinches North Melbourne head coach role after Buckley withdraws bid
item.description: Fremantle assistant coach Jaymie Graham has been appointed as the new North Melbourne head coach for the 2027 season.

item.title: Lula Leads in 52 Nations as Flávio Bolsonaro Claims 33 Countries
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads the presidential race among Brazilian voters living abroad across 85 countries with 156,889 total votes.

item.title: Joshua Zirkzee nets winner as Netherlands topple Serbia to lead group
item.description: The Netherlands secured a 2-1 Nations League victory over Serbia in Eindhoven to climb to the top of Group A2.

item.title: Germany dominates possession but settles for frustrating goalless draw in Greece
item.description: Germany played to a 0-0 stalemate against Greece in their Nations League match at Toumba Stadium.

item.title: Iga Swiatek Faces Donna Vekic in High Stakes WTA Beijing Third Round
item.description: World number one Iga Swiatek competes in the third round of the WTA Beijing tournament on Monday following Donna Vekic's victory over Lin Zhu.

item.title: Daly Cherry-Evans hunts fairytale NRL premiership in final career game
item.description: Sydney Roosters playmaker Daly Cherry-Evans plays his 379th and final NRL match in Sunday's grand final against the Newcastle Knights.

item.title: Cartel founder Christy Kinahan vanishes as Dubai residency visa officially expires
item.description: Irish police are searching for the 69-year-old crime figure after his mandatory departure deadline from Dubai passed on September 29th.

item.title: Knights topple Panthers as Sydney Roosters surge toward 16th premiership title
item.description: The Newcastle Knights and Sydney Roosters will clash in Sunday's NRL Grand Final at Accor Stadium.

item.title: China Open rocked as top seeds Sabalenka and Rybakina suffer early exits
item.description: World No. 2 Aryna Sabalenka was eliminated from the China Open in straight sets by Nikola Bartunkova on Sunday, following world No. 1 Elena Rybakina's departure one day earlier.

item.title: Dane Gagai snatches New Zealand eligibility switch for World Cup re-match
item.description: The 35-year-old Knights centre has been cleared to play for the Kiwis in the Rugby League World Cup opener on October 15.

item.title: James Tedesco and Kalyn Ponga clash in NRL grand final showdown
item.description: Fullbacks James Tedesco and Kalyn Ponga lead their respective teams into the NRL grand final this Sunday at Stadium Australia.

item.title: Mark Nawaqanitawase eyes NRL return after two-year rugby stint in Japan
item.description: Roosters winger Mark Nawaqanitawase will depart the NRL following Sunday's grand final against the Newcastle Knights to begin a two-year contract with the Saitama Wild Knights.

item.title: Channel 9 staff face October 18 deadline for new controversial employment contracts
item.description: Nine Network employees are currently holding secret meetings with unions regarding new workplace conditions that take effect on October 18.

item.title: Munster rookie Charlie O’Shea masterclass topples Bulls in 26-22 URC clash
item.description: The Bulls fell to a 26-22 loss against Munster at Thomond Park on Saturday night as 20-year-old Charlie O’Shea scored two tries.

item.title: Trump Predicts Big Midterm Surprise While Campaigning For Struggling Ohio Republicans
item.description: Donald Trump rallied in Ohio on Saturday to boost Senate candidate Jon Husted and gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy as midterm elections approach.

item.title: Former Wallaby Nathan Charles Diagnosed With Motor Neurone Disease at 37
item.description: Former Australia rugby player Nathan Charles has been diagnosed with motor neurone disease following months of declining health.

item.title: G7 leaders clinch deal to release 100 million barrels of diesel
item.description: The G7 group has committed to a coordinated release of 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil over four months to address surging energy prices.

item.title: Stars unite for emotional Jai Arrow tribute at NRL Grand Final show
item.description: Australian music artists will perform a tribute to Jai Arrow and Nathan Charles during the NRL Grand Final pre-game show on Sunday night.

item.title: Amol Rajan becomes first contestant murdered in second series of Celebrity Traitors
item.description: Journalist Amol Rajan was eliminated from the BBC reality show after being targeted by traitors Richard E. Grant and Maya Jama.
